title: 2001 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Snake
seo_title: 2001 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Snake (24 January – 11 February 2002)
description: 2001 is the Year of the Metal Snake (Yin, Xin-si), from 24 January 2001 to 11 February 2002. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2001.
lead: Born in 2001? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Snake, but check the date: the 2001 Metal Snake year began on 24 January 2001. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2001: Year of the Metal Snake, from 24 January 2001 to 11 February 2002.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2001 was the Year of the Snake. It began with Lunar New Year on 24 January 2001 and ended on 11 February 2002, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2001 ends in 1, which makes it a Metal year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2001 is a Xin-si year. The same Metal Snake combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1941 before it and 2061 after it.
Lunar New Year 2001 fell on 24 January 2001. Anyone born from 1 January 2001 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Dragon; from 24 January 2001 on, the Snake.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Snake guide describes the sign like this: “Wise, intuitive, and elegant. Snakes are deep thinkers who plan carefully before acting.” The usual watch-out: “Can be secretive or prone to overthinking.”

The Metal element adds its own flavour. Metal years bring discipline, ambition, and strong will. People of this element tend to be determined, independent, and value-driven. Read more in our Metal element guide, or the full Year of the Snake page.
Careers often linked with the Snake: finance, research, psychology, strategy.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2001
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Snake's best matches are the Ox, Rooster and Monkey, and its clash sign is the Pig, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Snake, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Snake, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Snake years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1977 (Fire Snake); 1989 (Earth Snake); 2013 (Water Snake); 2025 (Wood Snake). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2001 is the Year of the Snake, a Yin Metal Snake year (Xin-si).
When does the 2001 Year of the Snake start and end?
It starts on 24 January 2001 and ends on 11 February 2002.
I was born in January 2001. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 24 January 2001, you are a Dragon; from 24 January 2001 on, a Snake.
Metal. 2001 ends in 1, which belongs to Metal, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Snake compatible with?
Traditionally the Ox, Rooster and Monkey. The Snake's clash sign is the Pig.
